title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 06
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'partial extraction' method leaves
options: Some pillars for permanent support
No pillars of any size at all in the section
Pillars of any size in the section
All the coal of the section is extracted
questions.solution: Partial extraction leaves some pillars for long-term support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'gas monitoring system' in a mine must be
options: Installed only at the surface of the mine workings
Periodic but never continuous in its actual operation
Continuous and capable of detecting hazardous gas concentrations
Operated manually by the sirdar with the readings properly recorded
questions.solution: Continuous and capable of detecting hazardous concentrations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'first-aid' requirements in mines are prescribed under
options: The Companies Act 2013
Mines Act 1952 and CMR 2017
The Factories Act only
The Payment of Wages Act
questions.solution: Both Mines Act 1952 and CMR 2017.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'barrier pillar' is left to
options: Separate different panels or protect main workings
Allow the two panels to be worked at the same time
Keep the main haulage roadway of the mine dry
Support the entire weight of the overburden
questions.solution: Barrier pillars separate panels and protect main workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The ventilation system helps control coal dust by
options: Adding dust to the air currents
Regulate air temperature only
Increasing the dust in the air
Diluting and removing airborne dust
questions.solution: Dilutes and removes airborne dust.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire risk assessment' for mines evaluates
options: Only the type of the roof strata present
Only the depth of the working mine
No such assessment is needed at all
Ignition sources, fuel, and control measures
questions.solution: Fire risk assessment evaluates ignition sources, fuel, controls.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The stages of coal formation in order are
options: Peat → Lignite → Bituminous → Anthracite
Lignite → Peat → Anthracite → Bituminous
Bituminous → Anthracite → Peat → Lignite
Anthracite → Bituminous → Lignite → Peat
questions.solution: Coal stages progress: Peat → Lignite → Bituminous → Anthracite.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding rope must be tested for
options: Tensile strength and endurance
The colour of the rope only
Only the length of the rope
Only the diameter of the rope
questions.solution: Both tensile strength and endurance testing is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A coal dust explosion is more likely in roadways that are
options: Well ventilated and very dusty
Newly constructed and very dusty
Wet from water spraying systems
Dry and have accumulated coal dust
questions.solution: Dry roadways with accumulated coal dust are more likely.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'overflow water' from stowing must be
options: Collected and either reused or discharged after treatment
Left underground in the mined-out area to soak away for ever
Allowed to flood the underground mine workings
Used for the cooling of the ventilation fans
questions.solution: Collected and either reused or discharged after treatment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The gradient of a drift must be such that
options: It is kept absolutely level and flat
Water can be drained and transport is possible
It is very steep in the gradient of the drift
It is independent of the seam gradient
questions.solution: Water can be drained and transport is possible.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing ratio' refers to
options: The ratio of the time taken for the stowing
The ratio of the cost of the stowing material
The ratio of the weight of the stowing material to the coal
Volume of stowing material to volume of coal extracted
questions.solution: Stowing ratio is volume of material to volume of coal extracted.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drill pattern' for drifting depends on
options: The season of the year in the mining area
The number of the workers working at the face in the section
Rock conditions, drift dimensions, and explosive type
The brand of the drilling machine that is used
questions.solution: Rock conditions, drift dimensions, and explosive type.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar's primary responsibility during a blast is to
options: Ensure safety of all persons in the vicinity
The opening of the ventilation doors
The lighting of the fuse by hand alone
The counting of the fired shots only
questions.solution: Safety of all persons in the vicinity is the primary responsibility.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding rope must be replaced if its diameter decreases by more than
options: When the diameter of the winding rope decreases by 10 percent
When the diameter increases by 5 percent
When the diameter decreases by 1 percent
The prescribed percentage from the original diameter
questions.solution: More than the prescribed percentage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing pipeline' must be checked for
options: Wear, blockages, and leakage at regular intervals
Only the paint that is used on the pipeline
Only the length of the stowing pipeline
The temperature of the slurry that is carried in the line
questions.solution: Wear, blockages, and leakage regularly.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'surface survey' for mining establishes
options: The tonnage of the coal that has already been despatched from it
The depth of the overburden in the working open cast pit area
Control points and reference framework for mine development
The grade of the coal in the seam and in the floor workings
questions.solution: Surface surveys establish control for mine development.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'split system' of ventilation involves
options: Only the regulation of the air temperature of the mine
Only the removal of the blasting fumes after the firing of the shots
The use of only a single continuous airway underground
Dividing intake air into multiple splits to serve different sections
questions.solution: Dividing intake air into multiple splits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety helmet' of a mine rescue team member must have
options: No special feature at all of any kind
A flame safety lamp fitted on the helmet
A headlamp with a rubber outer shell
A cap lamp and communication device
questions.solution: A cap lamp and communication device.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire-resistant doors' in a mine must be
options: Installed at strategic locations to control ventilation and fire spread
Installed only at the surface portal of the mine shaft
Decorated with the company logos and the trade marks here
Fitted only at the main surface entrance of the mine portal of the shaft
questions.solution: Installed at strategic locations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'self-contained breathing apparatus' (SCBA) for mine rescue provides
options: Air from the underground mine workings
Compressed air supplied from the surface mine
No supply of air at all to the wearer
Fresh air supply independent of mine atmosphere
questions.solution: SCBA provides fresh air independent of mine atmosphere.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast report' should contain
options: The names of the persons who refused to fire that shot
The time at which the stemming of the shot hole was completed in the round
Type/quantity of explosive used, number of shots fired, and any misfires
The colour and the packing of the explosive that was used
questions.solution: Type/quantity of explosive used, number of shots fired, and any misfires.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The '5W1H' in report writing stands for
options: Word, Writing, Waiting, and Watching the work
Work, Worker, Wage, Welfare, Wellbeing, Health
Who, What, When, Where, Why, and How
Wage, Water, Wind, Wall, Wire, and Waste
questions.solution: Who, What, When, Where, Why, and How.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'communication system' for mine rescue must include
options: Hand signals between the members of the team
Loud shouts from the mine rescue station situated nearby
Visual signalling through the mine galleries
Two-way communication between rescue team and surface
questions.solution: Two-way communication between team and surface.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support density' in underground mines is expressed as
options: The prevention of water ingress
Load capacity per unit area (tonnes/m²)
The support of the conveyor belts
The number of the supports used
questions.solution: Support density is expressed as load capacity per unit area.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'humic coal' is formed from
options: Accumulated animal excreta
Higher plant material
Rock debris of overburden
Marine animal remains
questions.solution: Humic coal forms from higher plant material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rock bolt' is different from 'roof bolt' because
options: The rock bolt is of a much larger overall size
The rock bolt is of a much smaller overall size
They are used at the different depths of the same mine workings
Rock bolt is used in hard rock, roof bolt in coal mines
questions.solution: Rock bolts are for hard rock; roof bolts are specifically for coal mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'main fan' in mine ventilation is used to
options: Provide the primary airflow through the mine
Only the regulation of the air temperature
The removal of water from the mine workings
The heating of the whole mine in the winter
questions.solution: Provides the primary airflow through the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding rope must be examined by a competent person at
options: When the rope is damaged
Intervals exceeding one year
Intervals not exceeding 6 months
Only once in every year of service
questions.solution: Intervals not exceeding 6 months.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'wire mesh' in roof support is used to
options: The storing of the mine materials
Transport materials in the roadway
To increase the ventilation air
Prevent small pieces of roof from falling
questions.solution: Wire mesh prevents small roof pieces from falling.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Who must the sirdar inform immediately in case of a reportable accident?
options: The manager and DGMS
The safety officer only
The police
The mine surveyor only
questions.solution: The manager and DGMS must be informed immediately.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pilot hole' in raise boring is drilled to
options: Support the roof of the raise
Provide guidance for the reaming head
The removal of dust from the hole
The extraction of the mineral
questions.solution: Pilot holes provide guidance for reaming heads.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation records' must include
options: No such ventilation records are needed
The records of the engine room only
Air quantity, quality, and fan performance data
Control humidity in underground workings
questions.solution: Records must include quantity, quality, fan performance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When the sirdar finds that a safety device is defective, he must
options: Stop work and report to the manager
Fix it himself if possible
Record it in the daily diary
The work is continued as before
questions.solution: Work must be stopped and the manager must be notified.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safe distance' for persons during blasting depends on
options: The time of the day of the firing
The grade of the coal that is being mined
The charge weight and type of explosive used
The size of the drilling machine used
questions.solution: Charge weight and type of explosive.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The protection of electrical equipment in mines includes
options: Only the differential protection of the underground mine circuit
Only the earth fault protection of the underground cables and the panels here
Only the overcurrent protection of the underground cables here
Earth leakage protection, short circuit protection, and overload protection
questions.solution: Earth leakage, short circuit, and overload protection.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue team equipment' includes
options: SCBA, gas detectors, communication, first aid
A helmet and a pair of safety boots
A hand torch and a carbide safety lamp
No such rescue equipment is needed
questions.solution: Teams need SCBA, detectors, communication, first aid.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'angle of break' in blasting refers to
options: The angle of the ground vibration caused by the blasting
The angle of inclination of the borehole
The angle of the fragmented zone from the free face
The angle of the throw of the flyrock in the blast
questions.solution: Angle of break defines the extent of fragmentation from the free face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The accident report must contain
options: The tonnage of the coal that was lost in the shift
The plan of the place where the accident occurred in the mine workings
Details of the accident, injured person, cause, and witnesses
The cost of the machinery damaged in the accident
questions.solution: Details of the accident, injured person, cause, and witnesses.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A powered roof support (shield) can withstand
options: Protect electrical equipment
The support of the conveyor belts
The control of the dust emissions
Hundreds of tonnes of roof load
questions.solution: Can withstand hundreds of tonnes of roof load.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'oxygen deficiency' in mines can occur due to
options: It affects only the intake air shafts of the mine
The excess of oxygen that is present in the intake air of the mine
The increased speed of the main ventilation fans
Displacement by other gases, oxidation, and poor ventilation
questions.solution: Oxygen deficiency occurs from gas displacement, oxidation, poor ventilation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'development working' in mining involves
options: The closure of the mine workings
The building of the surface structures
The extraction of the coal pillars
Driving galleries to develop new panels
questions.solution: Development working drives galleries to develop new working panels.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'board and pillar' method of working involves
options: Driving headings and crosscuts to form pillars
Only the extraction of the coal pillars
Only the surface mining of the coal seams
The working with a single heading only
questions.solution: Driving headings and crosscuts to form pillars.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'photographic evidence' in a report helps to
options: The omission of the given references in it
The skipping of the executive summary page of the report itself
Provide visual documentation of conditions and evidence
The replacement of the written description
questions.solution: Provides visual documentation of conditions and evidence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine waste to stowing' ratio depends on
options: Only the colour of the stowing sand that is used
Only the type of the stowing pump that is used in the mine workings
Only the height of the coal seam that is mined
The volume of voids created and available waste material
questions.solution: Volume of voids and available waste.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A person winding in a shaft must be accompanied by
options: The inspector of the mines on duty
The winding engineman working alone
A competent person in charge of the shaft
The surface watchman of the mine only
questions.solution: A competent person in charge of the shaft.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'face charge' in drifting blasting is the
options: The charge fired from the surface of the mine only
The charge that is used for the roof support work
The total charge for the whole of the drift
Charge drilled and blasted at the face
questions.solution: Face charges are drilled and blasted at the working face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'wet drilling' in underground mines is done to
options: Reduce the noise level during the drilling work
Increase the life of the drill bit
Prevent the drill steel from overheating in the hole
Suppress dust generation during drilling
questions.solution: Wet drilling suppresses dust generation during drilling operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'total station' combines
options: A level and a compass only of the old type
A level, a compass, and a plane table
A measuring tape and a chain only of the old type
Theodolite, distance meter, and data recorder
questions.solution: Total stations combine theodolite, EDM, and data recorder.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'presplit blast' creates
options: A rough and a broken wall face
Clean, stable final wall surface
No visible result in the wall
The maximum fragmentation of the rock
questions.solution: Presplit blasting creates clean, stable final walls.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'inspection report' of a working place must include
options: Any unsafe condition, contravention, and corrective action taken
The writing without any sequential order of the inspection report itself
The complete skipping of the executive summary page
The names of all the persons working in that place
questions.solution: Any unsafe condition, contravention, and corrective action taken.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The Coal Mines Regulations (CMR) 2017 replaced
options: CMR 2014
CMR 1987
CMR 2000
CMR 1957
questions.solution: CMR 2017 replaced CMR 1987.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'mock drill' for mine rescue must be conducted
options: Only after a major accident has occurred
When the inspector demands
Only once in every five years
At regular intervals as prescribed
questions.solution: At regular intervals as prescribed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'rescue team leader' must have
options: Additional training in command and decision-making
No any special training for the rescue work of the team
Only the basic first aid training given
No knowledge of the mine workings at all
questions.solution: Additional training in command and decision-making.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety sign maintenance' must be
options: Regular inspection and replacement of damaged signs
Erected only once at the mine entrance
Done only by the mine surface security staff
Repainted at each of the annual shutdowns of the mine works
questions.solution: Safety signs must be regularly inspected and maintained.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'penalty for contravention' of provisions of the Mines Act can include
options: Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine, or both
A transfer of the mine manager elsewhere
A reduction in the wages of the miners
No penalty at all of any kind is levied
questions.solution: Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine, or both.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'shot firer' in a mine must hold
options: A written letter from the mine manager
A driving licence for the mine vehicles
A valid certificate of competency as prescribed
A certificate of the experience gained
questions.solution: A valid certificate of competency as prescribed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drill steel' used in drifting must be of
options: The correct length, diameter, and steel grade for the rock
Any length of the drill steel that is available
The cheapest of the drill steel sections available
Any type of the drill steel section that is available in the store
questions.solution: Correct length, diameter, and steel grade for the rock.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A feeder breaker is used to
options: To break only the hard rocks found in the coal seam
To transport the persons safely to the working face
To load the blasted coal into the mine dumpers of the section
Break large coal lumps and feed them to the belt conveyor
questions.solution: Breaks large coal lumps and feeds them to the belt conveyor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'face profiling' in drifting is done to
options: Measure the temperature of the rock strata
To test the ventilation of the working place in the mine
To measure the gas content of the seam
Check the excavation against the planned profile
questions.solution: Check excavation against planned profile.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar's report book is maintained under
options: Indian Penal Code
CMR 2017 Regulation 117
Mines Act 1952
Factory Act
questions.solution: The sirdar's report book is maintained under CMR 2017 Regulation 117.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the 'ventilation plan' must be approved by
options: The workers' union of the mine section
The ventilation officer of the mine alone
The manager and the Regional Inspector of Mines
The local police station of the area
questions.solution: The manager and the Regional Inspector of Mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A woman is permitted to work in a mine
options: Between 6 AM and 7 PM as per the Mines Act
At any hour of the day or of the night
During the night shift of the workings
With the consent of the inspector
questions.solution: Between 6 AM and 7 PM.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The condition for approaching water-logged workings under CMR 2017 requires
options: Boreholes to be drilled to probe the water-logged area
Rely only on the old plans and the old sections of the mine
No special precaution of any kind is needed
An inspection of the old plans of the mine
questions.solution: Boreholes must be drilled to probe the water-logged area.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'benchmark' in surveying is a
options: An unknown point of the mine survey
A temporary mark set on the ground
Fixed point of known elevation
A moving point of the survey
questions.solution: Benchmarks are fixed points of known elevation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'dust suppression' methods in coal mines include
options: Wetting the floor after every round
The sealing off of the return airway of the mine
No such methods are needed at all here
Water spraying, stone dusting, and ventilation
questions.solution: Dust suppression uses water, stone dusting, and ventilation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main function of a feeder breaker is to
options: Loading coal directly into railway wagons
Breaking the overburden ahead of the shovel face
Boring vertical holes for roof support bolts
Reduce size of coal and feed to belt conveyor
questions.solution: Reduces size of coal and feeds to belt conveyor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'borehole survey' determines
options: The tonnage of the coal that is drilled out
The depth of the seam below the floor level of the gallery
The width of the drilled bore hole itself
Position and orientation of boreholes underground
questions.solution: Borehole surveys determine position and orientation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine must be stopped if
options: It is the night shift of the mine
The workers are on their tea break
The production of the mine is low
There is any unusual noise or vibration
questions.solution: Must be stopped for any unusual noise or vibration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drift alignment' is maintained by
options: Survey control and reference points
The personal judgement of the manager
The alignment is not maintained
Only by the visual estimation
questions.solution: Drift alignment uses survey control and reference points.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing material testing' includes
options: The density and the bulk of the stowing material
The quantity of the stowing material that is used in the mine
Grain size, strength, permeability, and compatibility
The location of the stowing plant in use
questions.solution: Material testing covers grain size, strength, permeability, and compatibility.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The inspector of mines has the power to
options: Examination of the statutory registers alone
Questioning of the manager on record
Visits to the mine only after giving the prior notice
Enter, inspect, and examine any mine at any time
questions.solution: Enter, inspect, and examine any mine at any time.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that all workers under him
options: Work without breaks
Use only hand tools
Are above 21 years
Know the emergency plans
questions.solution: All workers must be aware of emergency procedures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'galleries' in board and pillar mining are driven at
options: Any width the drifter can cut
Random directions of the mine workings
Predetermined width and alignment
Random widths as encountered in the seam
questions.solution: Galleries are driven at predetermined widths and alignments.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety device on a conveyor belt includes
options: A reverse direction interlock device that is fitted on the belt drive
A device to detect the lumps carried in the belt
Emergency stop pull cord, belt drift switch, and speed sensor
An automatic tensioning device of the belt drive
questions.solution: Emergency stop pull cord, belt drift switch, and speed sensor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation plan' of a mine must be approved by
options: Only the regulation of the air temperature
The manager and the Regional Inspector of Mines
The prevention of the firedamp in the mine workings
The chief surveyor of the mine workings
questions.solution: The manager and the Regional Inspector of Mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'immediate roof' in coal mines refers to
options: The rock strata lying below the coal seam
The immediate surface of the coal seam
The roof layers directly above the coal seam
The main roof of the working only
questions.solution: Immediate roof is the roof layers directly above the coal seam.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pedestrian safety' measures include
options: No such measures are needed in the mine
Separate crossings at the shaft bottom
The provision of higher illumination at the mine dump
Designated walkways, barriers, visibility measures
questions.solution: Pedestrian safety needs walkways, barriers, visibility.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When methane concentration reaches 5-15% in air, it becomes
options: Explosive
Nonflammable
Not visible
Quite safe
questions.solution: Becomes explosive at 5-15% concentration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ripping' in underground mining is done to
options: The construction of roof supports in the gallery
The extraction of the coal seams by the mine workers of that section
Increase the height of a gallery by removing roof or floor rock
The decrease of the height of the roadway gallery
questions.solution: Ripping removes roof or floor rock to increase gallery height.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Synonym of 'Pragmatic' is
options: Impractical
Idealistic
Theoretical
Practical
questions.solution: Pragmatic means practical.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Parliament of India consists of
options: Only the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha
Only the Lok Sabha together with the President of India
Only the Rajya Sabha and the President
The President, the Lok Sabha, and the Rajya Sabha
questions.solution: Under Article 79 of the Constitution of India, the Parliament consists of the President, the Lok Sabha, and the Rajya Sabha.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Golden Temple' is located in
options: Delhi
Varanasi
Jaipur
Amritsar
questions.solution: Golden Temple is in Amritsar.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal supply' to power plants is managed by
options: Direct supply by private coal companies
State electricity boards through direct contracts
The Railways through the long term freight contracts given
CIL through its subsidiaries and e-auction platform
questions.solution: CIL through subsidiaries and e-auction.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The national flower of India is
options: Sunflower
Lotus
Jasmine
Rose
questions.solution: Lotus is the national flower.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Sundarbans is a
options: Volcanic region
Mountain range
Mangrove forest
Desert
questions.solution: Sundarbans is the world's largest mangrove forest.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Startup India' initiative promotes
options: Only for large industries
Only for mining companies
Nothing specific to any sector
Entrepreneurship and innovation
questions.solution: Entrepreneurship and innovation.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'stripping ratio' in opencast mining is the ratio of
options: Overburden to coal extracted
Coal extracted to overburden removed
Blast holes drilled to the coal won
The haul road length in metres
questions.solution: Overburden to coal extracted.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'bench' in opencast mining is
options: An inclined roadway driven down from the surface
A horizontal step-like working in an open cast mine
The vertical face that is left standing after the blasting
The sump built at the lowest point of the pit
questions.solution: A horizontal step-like working in an open cast mine.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'energy security' of India depends on
options: Exclusively on the imported crude oil for the plants
Exclusively on imported liquefied natural gas
Exclusively on renewable energy sources
Domestic coal production and import management
questions.solution: Domestic coal production and imports.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Statement: All birds can fly. Penguin is a bird. Conclusion: Penguin can fly. This is
options: None
Valid
Invalid
Cannot determine
questions.solution: Invalid syllogism — penguins cannot fly.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Find the next number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, ?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If 'ROCK' is related to 'HARD', then 'WATER' is related to ?
options: Wet
Flow
Liquid
Soft
questions.solution: Rock is hard; water is soft.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Currency of UK is
options: Dollar
Pound Sterling
Franc
Euro
questions.solution: Pound Sterling is UK's currency.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'volatile matter' in coal is
options: The mineral matter that is left after the complete burning of coal
The water that is held in the pores of the coal
The gases released when coal is heated in the absence of air
The fixed carbon remaining after heating in air
questions.solution: Gases released when coal is heated without air.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The deepest coal mine in India is located at
options: Singrauli
Talcher
Jharia
Raniganj
questions.solution: Jharia coalfield in Jharkhand has some of the deepest mines.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal supply monitoring' system tracks
options: Only the wages paid to the mine workers
Only the wagons loaded at the siding
